page.help: Members get their own voice channel when they need one. When someone joins the trigger channel, Mewvo makes a new voice channel for them and moves them into it. The channel is deleted again once it is empty.

status.title: Status
status.text: Join to create is {state} (it is on while there is a trigger channel).

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.removeConfirm: Stop using this channel as a trigger? The channel itself is kept.

add.title: New trigger
add.help: Mewvo makes a voice channel called "Join to Create". You can also do this with /jointocreate setup in Discord.
add.helpNoAdmin: Mewvo makes a voice channel called "Join to Create". You can also do this with /jointocreate setup in Discord. You need the Administrator permission in this server for this.
add.oneOnly: A server can have one trigger channel. Remove the current one to make a new one.

fields.name: Channel name
fields.nameHelp: The name of each new channel. You can use {username} (the member's username), {displayName} (their name in this server), {guildName} (the server name) and {channelName} (the trigger channel's name).
fields.bitrateHelp: Sound quality in the voice channel. Higher sounds better but needs a faster connection. 64 is normal. Boosted servers allow higher values.
fields.categoryHelp: A category is a folder of channels. The trigger channel is made in it.

action.removed: Trigger removed (the voice channel itself is kept).
